normalization.session_timestamp: convert the vendor timestamp in America/New_York to its session date, then store UTC midnight
normalization.open_high_low: multiply each vendor value by adjusted_close divided by close
normalization.close: multiply vendor close by adjusted_close divided by close, using the same Decimal factor as open/high/low
normalization.volume: use the vendor-reported integer volume unchanged

fallback.raw_evidence: retain every requested vendor bar field, adjusted close, vendor timestamp, normalized session date, validated metadata, source, and symbol
